title: Tinderwick - Lantern Lullaby (SNES register)
_note: SOURCE town theme + first full statement of the Vesper motif, re-voiced into the lush SNES register for the game's first impression. Same tune/identity as the gbc anchor (lead + hearth bass are unchanged note-for-note) but the 4-voice chip band is opened up: a warm sustained STRINGS pad carrying real chords (C-Am-F-G) under the motif, the music-box arp re-voiced as a PLUCK harp, sparse BELL glints for the Light signature at phrase ends, and a FLUTE descant answering the lead through the homesick B section. snes era => warm reverb 0.18 + chord stacking. 92 BPM, 4/4, C major with a wistful A-minor turn. 16-bar AABA-leaning loop.

tracks._note: UNCHANGED from the gbc anchor - the naked Vesper statement still sings on top. A: full statement. A': repeat. B: A-minor homesick turn. A'': resolve home.

tracks._note: NEW (SNES). Warm sustained string bed - the real chords the chip couldn't stack. Follows the harmonic rhythm: C - (G) - C - Am - C - Am - F/G - F/Am - G - C - Am/G - C/G turnaround. Soft, sits under the lead.
